file.description: Landed cost invoice file (required, max 20 MB). Accepts PDF and image scans: pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, tif, tiff, bmp, webp. Examples: freight, customs, brokerage, insurance, duty.

supplier_id.description: Optional. Pre-associate the extraction with a known supplier (must exist in suppliers). If omitted, the OCR pipeline attempts to fuzzy-match the extracted vendor_name against existing suppliers.

prebind_target_type.description: Optional. One of: inbound_shipment, purchase_order, warehouse_transfer. When set, the resulting extraction is pre-bound to a specific target so it appears as a candidate during apply.

prebind_target_id.description: Optional. ID of the prebind target. Required when prebind_target_type is set.
